rule:
Noise diagnostic, controlled noise-reduction test (Andre Leone, Lunaria).
Built from the EXISTING raw validation clips only; no generation.

The noise is the voices' own steady room tone (seed-independent, present in
the raw ElevenLabs MP3 under every pause). Two candidate treatments, both
applied to the trimmed raw clip BEFORE the unchanged guarded gain/limiter/
AAC chain:

E  pause expander: gain is reduced only where the 10 ms envelope sits near
   the voice's own measured noise floor; full range (8 dB) at the floor,
   none from floor+12 dB up. 15 ms look-ahead so word onsets open before
   they start; 5 ms open, 150 ms close. Speech itself passes at unity, and
   the spectrum of what remains is the original noise, only quieter.
S  spectral denoiser: ffmpeg afftdn, 8 dB reduction, noise floor set to the
   voice's measured floor, noise tracking on.

Measured per voice over all five clips: pause-floor change, speech-frame
change (overall and 4-10 kHz, i.e. consonants/air), the onset/decay/breath
zone change, and spectral flux of what remains in pauses (watery/'musical'
artefact indicator; 0 = unchanged texture).
Writes the guarded take of the better treatment for listening.
Usage: python noise_reduction_test.py <repo>
